fires when: Platform reports 0 conversions while the CRM has 3+ customers on the line
response: Exclude the week from platform metrics; raise with the ad platform

fires when: Platform/CRM ratio shifts by more than 15% (p < 0.01, at least 8 weeks each side)
response: Freeze platform-based reporting for the line; investigate the tag

fires when: Share of leads repeating a contact within 30 days rises above today's 2.9%
response: Fix at entry; B2 lead counts use de-duplicated data

fires when: Spend changes by more than 5% after first report
response: Use the restated cost; close weeks only after restatements

fires when: Actual quarterly customers or contribution outside the 80% range
response: Investigate; refit the forecast; check for an unlogged change

fires when: A new test's measured effect falls outside the model's 10-90% range for that change
response: Refit with the new test; re-run the optimiser and sensitivity

fires when: Contribution after ad spend below the plan's pessimistic case for two months running
response: Review the lines that moved; check holdout results

fires when: Qualified leads above 40 a week for four weeks
response: Cap B2 spend or hire; leads above capacity are wasted

fires when: Any business's incremental-CAC payback above its target
response: Shift budget out of the business's lowest-return line

fires when: Any sentence fails the code checks after the retry, or a draft ships without sign-off
response: Template fallback; reviewer must approve the exact draft
